description: The chart illustrates performance metrics for five sentence-embedding model variants by showing three measures per model: Sentiment Accuracy, STS Correlation, and Paraphrase Accuracy. The horizontal axis contains the model categories (left to right): Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy / Correlation” and uses a linear scale from 0 to about 0.9, with regularly spaced tick marks at approximately 0.2 intervals (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). Each category has a grouped set of three vertical bars: a pale yellow bar for Sentiment Acc., a pink bar for STS Corr., and a light blue bar for Paraphrase Acc., arranged side-by-side within each group. For Single-task_baseline, the Sentiment Acc. bar is around 0.53, the STS Corr. bar around 0.50, and the Paraphrase Acc. bar around 0.79. For Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Sentiment Acc. is about 0.52, STS Corr. about 0.58, and Paraphrase Acc. about 0.78–0.79. For Unsupervised_SimCSE, Sentiment Acc. is about 0.53, STS Corr. about 0.72, and Paraphrase Acc. about 0.77–0.78. For Supervised_SimCSE, Sentiment Acc. is about 0.49, STS Corr. about 0.80, and Paraphrase Acc. about 0.78. For 2-Tier SimCSE, Sentiment Acc. is about 0.49, STS Corr. about 0.81, and Paraphrase Acc. about 0.78–0.79. The bars are not shown as explicitly sorted by value, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the color legend at the top.
